intro.text: A Hearthstone man who serves the citylord, Brightlord Roshone.
The gardener at the citylord's manor in Hearthstone.

items.text: In 1168, when Amaram came to Hearthstone to recruit, Roshone had Waber gather the townspeople for a meeting, and Waber and his helpers put up a canopy in the town square.

During the evacuation of Hearthstone to Urithiru in 1175, Waber was among a group seized by a Fused and a few of his soldiers to draw Kaladin out. When Kaladin arrived, the singers withdrew into the manor but let Waber and the others go.
